summary: This is a Form 6-K (press release) filed by GasLog Partners LP, a foreign private issuer, reporting its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing highlights a completed vessel sale (Methane Rita Andrea for $34.1 million, finalized May 8, 2026) and routine quarterly dividend declarations on its preference units. No special situation event (merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, etc.) is present. The vessel sale is an ordinary-course asset disposal, and the dividend declarations are standard recurring distributions. The filing is a routine earnings report with no transformative corporate action requiring classification as a special situation. Therefore, it falls under 'None'.
